title: How Does Local Landscape Geometry Evolve in Language Model Pre-Training?
abstract: arXiv:2609.39767v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The scale and expense of pre-training language models make efficient hyperparameter tuning essential, yet a principled guidance is still missing. In this work, we analyze language model pre-training dynamics from a local landscape geometry perspective. Our study reveals two distinct phases. In Phase I, sharpness of the local landscape is initially high, leading to instability and loss plateaus under large learning rates (LRs). The landscape shifts from sharp to flatter regions early in training. This dynamic explains the necessity of LR warmup and further suggests that larger peak LRs require proportionally longer warmup periods. In Phase II, the local landscape is governed by the gradient noise scale. Our theory identifies a depth flatness trade-off: high noise from smaller batches widens the loss basin, whereas reduced noise from larger batches deepens it. translated_title: 语言模型预训练中局部景观几何如何演化？
translated_abstract: 预训练语言模型的规模和高昂成本使得高效的超参数调优至关重要，然而目前仍缺乏有原则性的指导。在本工作中，我们从局部景观几何的视角分析语言模型预训练的动态过程。我们的研究揭示了两个截然不同的阶段。在阶段I中，局部景观的锐度初始较高，导致在大学习率（LR）下的不稳定性以及损失平台期。在训练早期，景观从尖锐区域转移到更平坦的区域。这一动态解释了学习率预热的必要性，并进一步表明较大的峰值学习率需要成比例更长的预热时间。在阶段II中，局部景观由梯度噪声尺度主导。我们的理论识别了一种深度-平坦度权衡：小批量带来的高噪声会拓宽损失盆地，而大批量降低噪声则会使损失盆地加深。这一理论启发了一种动态批量大小（BS）调度器，其从……开始（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本研究从局部景观几何视角揭示语言模型预训练分为两个阶段——早期景观由锐变平解释了学习率预热的必要性，后期景观由梯度噪声尺度主导并存在批大小带来的“深度-平坦度”权衡，从而为动态批量大小调度提供了理论依据。
en_tdlr: This study reveals two phases in language model pre-training from a local landscape geometry perspective: the early sharp-to-flat transition explains the necessity of LR warmup, while the later gradient-noise-scale-driven phase uncovers a depth-flatness trade-off in batch size, motivating a dynamic batch-size scheduler.
